description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 08.03.2021 to 14.08.2021
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, falls under statutory instruments/subsidiary legislation, and rescinds a previous notification. This fits Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with regulatory compliance requirements for customs operations rather than government personnel/structure changes.
